data.headline: Brightwave Logistics saved 1,840 hours in Q3, 22 percent more than in Q2, with 96 of 120 seats active.
data.usage_note: Active seats grew from 18 in February to 97 in October, and grew every month. August added 11 seats, the month of the dispatch rollout to the Chicago yard.
data.adoption_note: Dispatch has 38 of its 40 seats active and Customer service 24 of 30. Fleet maintenance, Finance and Sales have 16 seats not yet active between them.

plan.what: Agree the Q4 targets on a 30-minute call.
Roll out to the Dallas terminal: 28 new seats, with the same two sessions of training as Chicago.
Bring the 24 seats not yet in use into use, starting with finance, fleet maintenance and sales.

data.next_note: The Dallas rollout adds 28 seats before the renewal date, so it is the one thing to settle first. The 5 Nov call is the place to do it. Pick a time and I will take you through the plan.
